title: A buliban
intro: You play Ioana, from Cluj, at a friend's party. You think you recognise someone. Is it Balázs?

a.text: Egy férfi áll az ablaknál. Szerinted ő Kis Balázs, a barátod kollégája.
a.textEn: A man is standing by the window. You think he's Balázs Kis, your friend's colleague.

choices.textEn: Excuse me! Are you Balázs Kis? (informal)

choices.note: Formal is Ön Kis Balázs? with no van. At a party with young people, te is fine.

choices.textEn: Excuse me! Are you Balázs Kis?

choices.note: He said he's NOT Balázs. Apologise!

c.speaker: Kornél
c.text: Semmi baj. És te ki vagy?
c.textEn: No problem. And who are you?

choices.textEn: I'm Ioana. Nice to meet you.

d.speaker: Kornél
d.text: Én is nagyon örülök. Budapesti vagy?
d.textEn: Nice to meet you too. Are you from Budapest?

choices.text: Nem, kolozsvári vagyok, de Budapesten élek.
choices.textEn: No, I'm from Cluj, but I live in Budapest.

choices.note: You're at the party, so you're not in Cluj! From Cluj = kolozsvári.

d-oops.speaker: Kornél
d-oops.text: Most Kolozsváron vagy? De itt vagy a buliban!
d-oops.textEn: You're in Cluj now? But you're here at the party!

choices.text: Bocsánat! Kolozsvári vagyok, de Budapesten élek.
choices.textEn: Sorry! I'm from Cluj, but I live in Budapest.

e.speaker: Kornél
e.text: Szuper! És magyarul is beszélsz! Milyen nyelven beszélsz még?
e.textEn: Great! And you speak Hungarian too! What other languages do you speak?

choices.text: Románul és angolul beszélek. Most magyarul tanulok.
choices.textEn: I speak Romanian and English. Now I'm learning Hungarian.

choices.note: Understandable! For “in a language” add -ul: románul, angolul.

end-great.text: Kornél introduces you to everyone. Great conversation!

end-ok.text: Kornél smiles: “Románul és angolul!” You're learning fast.
